title: gccom-mole-experiments: verification and validation of a mimetic internal-wave solver on fully curvilinear grids
description: Two-dimensional linear non-hydrostatic internal-wave solver on fully curvilinear grids using the MOLE mimetic operator library. Verified against the exact dispersion relation of a free internal seiche (second-order convergence to zero once the lateral Robin regularisation is small). Validation against the internal-wave-beam benchmark of Garcia et al. (2019), J. Comput. Sci. 30:143-156, sec. 3.3, is in progress: earlier 20-period beam-angle results were found not to be converged in time and are being re-measured with a smooth forcing ramp, and a numerical instability near steeper topography on fine grids has been identified, reproduced cheaply, and is under investigation. Includes a grid/operator cache and an optional multithreaded PARDISO pressure solver.
